items.subject: mRNA-1273 cost-effectiveness analysis
items.statement: ICER is $22,900 per QALY gained using a 10-year time horizon, US payer perspective, and 3% discount rate

items.subject: COVID-19 disease burden
items.statement: Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 475,501 with direct medical costs exceeding $22 billion and indirect costs of approximately $40 billion annually
items.supporting_quote: Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 475,501, with direct medical costs exceeding $22 billion. Indirect costs including productivity losses add an estimated $40 billion annually.

items.subject: mRNA-1273 budget impact analysis
items.statement: 5-year net savings are $29M based on a plan size of 1,000,000 covered lives with 61% vaccination rate assumption
items.supporting_quote:
Plan Size Modeled: 1,000,000 covered lives
Vaccination Rate Assumed: 61%
5-Year Net Savings: $29M
